* **Collaboration:**

  Improve system performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* **Troubleshooting:**
  Identify and resolve backend issues efficiently.

: Proactive monitoring and collaboration with team members and internal departments are necessary to guarantee seamless operations at the Centre.

jobs.title: Java Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)
jobs.description:
We're Hiring: Backend Engineer (HMS) – MedOrbit, an AI-Native Hospital Platform

This isn't a "maintain a CRUD app" role. MedOrbit is already live with paying hospitals, runs the full clinical and operational spine of a hospital, and has 11 AI agents in production under clinician control. You'll build the backend that doctors, nurses, lab technicians, pharmacists and billing teams use every day.

Role Details

Position: Java Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)

Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (On-site, 5 days a week)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–4 years

Joining: Immediate joiners strongly preferred

Mandatory: Hands-on experience developing Java microservice, Devops, Database, AWS cloud

About MedOrbit

MedOrbit (by AI Nexus Innovations Hub) is a multi-tenant hospital management platform built for Indian healthcare. One codebase serves 24 facility types, from a solo doctor's clinic to a 500-bed super-specialty hospital, pathology labs, imaging centres, dialysis chains, blood banks and retail pharmacies.

What You'll Do

Core HMS Modules

  Build and extend Java / Spring Boot microservices across patient registration, appointments, OPD/IPD workflows, bed management, lab orders, pharmacy inventory, billing and insurance claims

Design REST APIs and database schemas that work across 24 facility types without forking the codebase

mplement module licensing and multi-tenant data isolation so each hospital sees only what it has licensed

Healthcare Integrations

Work on ABDM flows: ABHA creation/linking, consent management, HIP/HIU data exchange

Build and maintain FHIR R4 resources, HL7 messages from lab analysers, and DICOM integration with PACS

Support NHCX claim submission and TPA workflows

AI Integration

Integrate Python-based AI services (ambient scribe, lab report intelligence, X-ray analysis, claim-denial guard) into the core platform

Build the APIs, queues and audit trails that let AI outputs appear inside doctor workflows, with clinician approval recorded every time

Reliability & Compliance

Write unit and integration tests, review code, and fix production issues quickly

Build audit logs, role-based access control, consent tracking and data-erasure features for DPDP and NABH compliance

Optimise queries and APIs for hospitals with high daily patient volumes

Tech Stack

Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Python (AI services), Docker, AWS, Git, CI/CD

What You Bring

Must-Have:

B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science or related field (2024–2026 batches welcome)

Hands-on experience building an HMS, EHR/EMR, LIS, RIS, pharmacy or clinic management system. Be ready to walk us through the modules you built, the database design, and the problems you solved

Strong fundamentals in Java and Spring Boot

Good understanding of REST APIs, SQL, joins, indexing and data modelling

Understanding of hospital workflows: patient registration → consultation → orders → billing → discharge

Working knowledge of Git, Docker and Linux

Clear communication – you'll work with doctors and hospital staff, not just engineers

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points!):

Exposure to FHIR, HL7, DICOM, ABDM, LOINC or ICD codes

Microservices architecture, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Redis caching

AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and CI/CD pipelines

Experience with insurance/TPA billing or GST-compliant invoicing

Basic Python or experience integrating ML/LLM services

Frontend exposure (React / Angular) for full-stack debugging

How We Work

Small team, short decision path, direct access to the founders. Specifications are written down and taken seriously. We ship continuously to a live production platform, and features are validated with real hospital users, not in a conference room.

Why Join AI Nexus?

Build a live HMS used by real hospitals from Day 1

Work on India's healthcare digital stack: ABDM, FHIR, NHCX

See how AI agents are built into a production hospital platform

Fast-track career growth in a high-potential health-tech startup

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

* Evaluate business requirements and functional specifications to develop scalable technical solutions, integrations, and application enhancements.
* Design, develop, test, and support customizations and extensions for Oracle EBS and Oracle Cloud applications.
* Build and maintain integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, web services, file-based integrations, and middleware technologies.
* Develop technical solutions using PL/SQL, SQL, Oracle Forms, Reports, BI Publisher, XML Publisher, OAF, Oracle APEX, and Oracle Cloud technologies.
* Design and implement automation solutions leveraging AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and intelligent workflow technologies to improve business productivity and operational efficiency.
* Develop AI-assisted applications, chatbots, copilots, intelligent document processing, and workflow automation solutions using modern AI frameworks and cloud services.
* Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance application performance, integrations, and database processes.
* Collaborate with Functional IT teams to analyze requirements, estimate effort, and deliver high-quality solutions.
* Support Oracle EBS and Oracle Cloud upgrades, enhancements, data migrations, and transformation initiatives.
* Develop and consume APIs, microservices, and event-driven integrations to support enterprise business processes.
* Build dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions for IT and business stakeholders.
* Research emerging Oracle, AI, cloud, and automation technologies and propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards, security, and best practices.
* Manage development activities and prioritize tasks according to project and business requirements.
* Work effectively in Agile and Waterfall project environments and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 1-2 years of experience in software development, Oracle application development, or enterprise application support.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle EBS Technical Stack and/or Oracle Cloud Technologies.
* Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, SOAP Services, Oracle Integration patterns, and middleware concepts.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, and PL/SQL.
* Understanding of Oracle technologies such as:

+ Oracle EBS Technical
+ Oracle Forms & Reports
+ OAF (Oracle Application Framework)
+ BI Publisher
+ Oracle APEX
+ Oracle Cloud ERP Technical Components
+ Oracle Visual Builder (VBCS) (preferred)

* Understanding of AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, AI agents, and automation platforms.
* Experience developing automation scripts, workflow solutions, APIs, and data integration solutions.
* Familiarity with Git, JIRA, CI/CD pipelines, and software development best practices.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* High energy, self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently.
* Ability to work effectively in global teams and Offshore-Onsite delivery models.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.

jobs.description:
**About Albertsons:**

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2,200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known global banners, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others. Our success is built upon a united team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. This customer-centric focus not only inspires innovation but has also led to remarkable achievements across our digital platforms and omnichannel strategies. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we have transformed shopping into an experience that is not just easy and efficient, but also fun and engaging. Over the past year, we have taken bold, strategic steps to migrate and modernize our enterprise data hub on Google Cloud, revolutionizing our data capabilities, thus becoming the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company.

**About Tech Hub in India:**

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence.

We are excited to announce an opening for Software Engineer I, AI Engineering (AIDLC) at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities.

**Position Title:**
Software Engineer I, AI Engineering (AIDLC)

**Roles & responsibilities:**

* Build and test parts of agents for the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) pod, guided by senior engineers.
* Contribute to agents for stages of the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support.
* Implement tool/function calling and use MCP servers, including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP, in the agents you work on.
* Implement RAG pipelines and basic memory and state handling for your agents.
* Write evals for the parts you build: a small golden dataset, simple LLM-as-judge checks and regression tests. Run them before each change.
* Add tracing and logging to your agents, and use traces to debug failures.
* Follow the pod's guardrails, including prompt-injection defenses and human-in-the-loop approval points.
* Write production code every week. Use agentic coding tools daily (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and check every change they produce before you commit it.
* Take part in code and agent reviews, and learn from the feedback.
* Report how your agents perform against the baseline the pod sets, and learn to watch token cost.
* Work with senior engineers and partner teams to meet security and compliance standards.

**Experience Required:**

* AI experience is a MUST. You have built an LLM agent or RAG application end to end, with at least one eval. An AI internship, coursework or a personal project counts. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo.
* 1-3 years of software engineering experience. Recent graduates with a strong AI project or internship are welcome to apply. There is no CGPA cutoff.
* Programming fundamentals in Python, Java or TypeScript: you write clean, tested code.
* Prompt engineering basics, and tool/function calling and MCP basics. Frameworks are examples only (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK).
* Understanding of RAG and of how an agent keeps memory and state.
* Understanding of how to evaluate an LLM application with a golden dataset, and why tracing matters.
* Responsible use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor): you review and understand code before you accept it, and you know when not to trust the output.
* A plus: cloud exposure on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform.
* Willingness to learn from code reviews and from senior engineers.

**Competencies:**

* Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others.
* Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason
* Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics.
* Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
* Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help.
* Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally
* Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work
* Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens
* Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space.
* Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
The Radar Firmware group in Bangalore is seeking a talented and experienced Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our team developing cutting-edge, safety-certified firmware for TI's industry-leading mmWave Radar portfolio. This role offers the opportunity to work on mission critical radar systems that power next-generation automotive ADAS/autonomous driving features and transformative industrial sensing on drones and other defense applications.
  
  
As an Embedded Firmware Engineer, some of your key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Design and develop ISO 26262 ASIL-D and IEC 61508 SIL-3 compliant embedded firmware for TI's mmWave radar sensors and processors.
* Implement real-time radar control firmware for configuration, calibration and high speed data acquisition on TI's mmWave radar sensors.
* Develop firmware using fault-tolerant, fail-safe architectures with comprehensive diagnostic coverage and safety mechanisms.
* Develop customer RF evaluation applications, tools, and RF test firmware for production tests.
* Develop easy-to-use and scalable interface libraries to abstract and simplify customer usage of our sensors.
* Collaborate with hardware teams to define firmware-hardware interfaces from a software usage, compatibility, performance, and reuse potential perspectives
* Develop automated testing frameworks and contribute to CI/CD pipelines
* Support customer engagements and provide technical expertise for product integration
* Support safety audits and assessments with TÜV/external certification bodies

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Requirements:**

* Min 1 year of experience in the domain of embedded systems firmware development.
* Good understanding of embedded real time systems firmware programming and engineering principles.
* Highly competent with C, assembly language, compilers and linkers.
* Experience with bare-metal firmware development.
* Experience in scripting languages like python, perl, lua, etc.
* Exposure to debugging critical embedded software systems issues with JTAG, trace and logic analyzer tools.
* Exposure to SW development life cycles, unit, integration and qualification of the FW.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with mixed signal analog and digital SOC and ROM firmware development.
* Experience with analog circuit FW driver development and calibrations algorithms.
* Electronics engineering graduate with firmware development background.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results
* Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions

**About Us**
**Why TI?**

* Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
* Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well-being is important to us. Please find our country-specific benefits here

**About Texas Instruments**
Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .
  
  
Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment.
  
  
If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.
  
  
**About The Team**
TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require an export license or decline to move forward with your employment.

jobs.title: Associate Developer
jobs.description:
**Bangalore, Hybrid**
**About Accuris**
Accuris is a global information and technology company providing trusted data, intelligence, and workflow solutions to professionals across highly specialized industries. Our solutions empower engineers, researchers, and technical professionals to make informed decisions, improve productivity, and solve complex challenges.
  
  
By combining deep domain expertise with innovative technology, Accuris is transforming how technical information is accessed, understood, and applied.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated
**Associate Developer**
to join our engineering team. This role is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about software development, problem-solving, and building reliable, scalable applications.
  
  
You will collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to develop, enhance, test, and maintain software solutions across our product portfolio. The successful candidate should have a strong programming foundation, a willingness to learn new technologies, and the ability to adapt to evolving technical requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Software Development**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain software applications and product features under the guidance of senior developers.
* Write clean, readable, maintainable, and efficient code in accordance with established coding standards.
* Assist in implementing application components, APIs, integrations, and backend or frontend functionality, depending on project requirements.
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality and development practices.

**Testing and Troubleshooting**

* Write and execute unit tests and support integration and regression testing.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve software defects with guidance from senior team members.
* Assist in debugging application issues and documenting root causes and resolutions.
* Contribute to improving application reliability, performance, and maintainability.

**Collaboration and Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with developers, QA engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
* Maintain technical documentation and follow established development workflows.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies, development frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Learn and apply new programming languages, tools, and technologies as required by business needs.

Key Stakeholders
  
  

* Software Engineering and Product Development teams
* Quality Assurance and Testing teams
* Product Management
* DevOps and other technical teams
* Cross-functional business stakeholders

**Requirements**
**Technical Skills**

* Foundational knowledge of at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and basic software engineering principles.
* Familiarity with relational databases and SQL.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, application architecture, and software development life cycles.
* Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
* Understanding of software testing, debugging, and code quality practices.

**Preferred (Not Required)**

* Exposure to web development frameworks, backend technologies, or modern application development tools.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containers, or automated testing.
* Experience with academic, internship, or personal software development projects.
* Exposure to Agile or Scrum methodologies.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Fresh graduates and candidates with up to 2 years of relevant development experience are encouraged to apply.
* Equivalent practical experience supported by relevant projects may also be considered.

What We're Looking For
  
  
**Problem-Solving and Learning Agility**

* Demonstrates logical thinking, analytical ability, and an interest in solving technical problems.
* Can understand unfamiliar technical concepts and apply feedback effectively.
* Shows curiosity and a willingness to learn new programming languages, frameworks, and tools.

**Communication and Teamwork**

* Communicates technical concepts and progress clearly.
* Works collaboratively and contributes positively to a team environment.
* Is receptive to feedback and comfortable seeking guidance when needed.

**Ownership and Adaptability**

* Takes responsibility for assigned tasks and follows through on commitments.
* Demonstrates attention to detail and a quality-oriented mindset.
* Adapts to changing priorities and works effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Why Join Accuris?
  
  

* Work on technology solutions that support engineering and technical professionals worldwide.
* Learn from experienced engineers and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Develop your technical expertise through hands-on projects and continuous learning.
* Contribute to meaningful product improvements while building a strong foundation for your software engineering career.

**Accuris is an equal opportunity employer.**
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals from diverse backgrounds can contribute, grow, and succeed. Employment decisions are made without discrimination in accordance with applicable laws.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
1% Club is an education-led fintech platform that helps people make smarter decisions with their money.
  
  
Founded by Sharan Hegde and Raghav Gupta, 1% Club was built on a core belief: financial literacy is the first step to financial independence. That belief built India's most trusted personal finance education brand, and has since evolved into a fintech platform with an app that helps users invest, plan, and manage their money in one place, powered by AI.
  
  
**Company Snapshot**
***Headquarters*
:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
Team Size: 200+
  
  
Backed by
**Gruhas**
(Nikhil Kamath)
  
  
**What We Do**
*Financial Education*
7L+ learners across personal finance, taxation, insurance, credit cards, and investing through live masterclasses and a subscription-based membership.
  
  
*Fintech Services*
The 1% Club app is built to replace the traditional bank RM with something smarter, faster, and always available. It combines an AI finance copilot with a curated set of financial products, including mutual fund baskets, fixed deposits, and stock baskets, with plans to solve for credit cards, taxation, insurance, and loans over time. For users who want deeper guidance, the app offers Personal CFO, a premium SEBI-registered advisory service for end-to-end financial planning. Insurance advisory is handled through Pillow, an independent vertical focused on transparent, long-term protection.
  
  
**Compliance & Governance**
1% Club operates under:
  
  
SEBI-registered Investment Advisor (RIA) license
  
  
SEBI-registered Research Analyst (RA) license
  
  
Trust is the foundation. Compliance is how we protect it.
  
  
**The Road Ahead**
Build the simplest, smartest way for Indians to manage their money, end to end, in one app. The modern replacement for your bank RM.
  
  
Come build it with us.
  
  
**🎯 What will you do?**
You’ll be working on the core systems behind a platform that's redefining how millions of Indians manage their money, with real-time applications, AI copilots, and blazing-fast apps.
  
  
You’ll have end-to-end ownership of features, working directly with the CTO and founding team to take ideas from whiteboard to production.
  
  
We care less about what stack you’ve used and more about how you think. You should be fluid across tech, know the “why” behind every decision, and treat speed and stability like religion. If you can write clean code, debug production like a ninja, and nerd out on system-level optimization, we’d love to have you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain high-throughput, low-latency applications for mission-critical systems using Golang, Typescript.
* Work closely with Product Managers, Designers & Backend Engineers to deliver seamless user experiences.
* Break down complex user problems into simple, scalable backend solutions.
* Own entire features end to end, taking responsibility for coding, unit testing, bug fixing & documentation.
* Participate in architectural discussions, contribute to the tech roadmap, and drive technical strategy.

**🤩 You’ll be a great fit if you have**

* 0–2 years of experience in a Backend SDE role, preferably in a fintech company.
* Proficiency in GoLang and experience with other programming languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript is a plus.
* Ownership and obsession with the product.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.

**🤌 Bonus points**

* You can use AI to automate grunt work and 10x your output
* You have a good eye for details
* You think like a product owner, not just an engineer
* You have worked at a FinTech before

**🤙 Perks And Benefits**

* BYOS (Build Your Own Setup): Mac/Windows/Linux, iPad, Monitors - anything you need to work comfortably.
* Work hard, Party harder: Company offsite, team lunch/dinner, game nights, and day outings are a few of the many things you’ll experience if you work out of the Bengaluru office.
* Highly competitive salary: We offer above-market salary & equity packages.

jobs.description:
**Bangalore, Hybrid**
**About Accuris**
Accuris is a global information and technology company providing trusted data, intelligence, and workflow solutions to professionals across highly specialized industries. Our solutions empower engineers, researchers, and technical professionals to make informed decisions, improve productivity, and solve complex challenges.
  
  
By combining deep domain expertise with innovative technology, Accuris is transforming how technical information is accessed, understood, and applied.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a curious and technically motivated
**Junior AI Developer**
to join our team and contribute to the development of AI-powered applications and intelligent product capabilities.
  
  
In this role, you will work with experienced developers, AI/ML specialists, and product teams to build, test, and integrate AI-driven solutions. You will gain hands-on exposure to machine learning concepts, large language models (LLMs), data processing, APIs, and AI application development.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a solid programming foundation, an interest in artificial intelligence, and the ability to learn and apply emerging technologies to practical business and product challenges.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**AI Application Development**

* Assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining AI-powered applications and product features.
* Support the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into existing applications and workflows.
* Work with APIs and AI frameworks to build application features that use machine learning models or large language models.
* Assist in developing and maintaining prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and production-ready AI features under the guidance of senior team members.
* Write clean, modular, maintainable code and follow established engineering practices.

**Data Processing and Model Integration**

* Assist in preparing, cleaning, transforming, and validating data for AI-related applications.
* Support the implementation and evaluation of AI/ML models and model-powered services.
* Experiment with prompts, model configurations, and retrieval techniques to improve the quality and relevance of AI-generated outputs.
* Assist with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, or document-processing workflows where applicable.
* Help evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, and reliability.

**Testing, Performance, and Responsible AI**

Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

**Job Description**

Team Description:
  
  
LSS (LinkedIn Sales Solutions) is the leading Sales Intelligence for LinkedIn's 1.2 Billion+ member network to help sales professionals find and build relationships with prospects and customers through social selling. LSS is one of the fastest growing revenue lines of LinkedIn. Our flagship product for sales professionals, Sales Navigator, is leading the revolution for social selling by connecting buyers and sellers in a whole new way. Serving both large enterprises and individual consumers, Sales Navigator is a SaaS product that helps sales professionals target the right people, understand their accounts, and engage at the right time.
  
  
  
  
Creating economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce is a responsibility we all share. To truly transform the global economy, we must evolve the way we hire and enable our talent to serve people of all backgrounds and experiences. LinkedIn is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
  
  
This role will be based in Bangalore, India.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
  
  
  
  
Responsibilities

* You will own the full stack development for one or more of our products and collaborate with visual/interaction designers, other engineers, and product managers to launch new products, iterate on existing features, and build a world-class user experience.
* You will implement cutting-edge technologies and write state-of-the-art code that keeps LinkedIn at the forefront of innovation.
* Your specific expertise will be required to make the site delightful, secure, performant and accessible to all our members and customers.
* You will review others' work and share knowledge.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications

* Bachelor's in Computer Science or related technical discipline, or related practical experience.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in developing backend services in Java and web development experience with object-oriented JavaScript, semantic HTML, CSS.
* Extensive programming experience in modern JavaScript / TypeScript / similar languages; frameworks such as EmberJS / React / similar and building APIs

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience developing multi-tier scalable and user-centric reliable applications that operate 24x7
* Deep foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms
* Knowledge of UI and API frameworks and MVP application design

Suggested Skills

* Java
* Javascript
* HTML
* CSS

You will Benefit from our Culture

We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families. That is why we offer generous health and wellness programs and time away for employees of all levels.

**Additional Information**

**India Disability Policy**

LinkedIn is an equal employment opportunity employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. For more information on our equal opportunity policy, please visit https://legal.linkedin.com/content/dam/legal/Policy\_India\_EqualOppPWD\_9-12-2023.pdf

jobs.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
  
  
We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
  
  
**Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?**
Cohesity is looking for a Front End Software Engineer to join one of our largest teams in Cloud Vertical. With millions of documents, terabytes of emails, and endless Teams conversations, we deal with unprecedented data volumes that require unique strategies and algorithms to process data efficiently. Keeping pace with the changing nature of products while ensuring seamless protection is a puzzle we solve every day. Our team tackles these challenges head-on with creativity, technical expertise, and a passion for excellence. Through mentorship, cross-training, and constant learning, you’ll grow your skills in ways you never imagined. Be part of a mission-critical team to protect the data that drives businesses across the world.
  
  
As a Front End Software Engineer, you will be an individual contributor focused on delivering features with high quality, along with continuous quality improvements with the help of automation. Working on the UI, you’ll be expected to coordinate with Product Management and User Experience team on the mock-ups as well as with the backend engineers on the interfaces and end-to-end testing. There will be a large variety of features to work on including: distributed and parallel data flows, cloud services, asynchronous programming, performance optimization, infinite scalability, snapshots, resiliency, multiple protocols, and fault tolerance.
  
  
We are a passionate team of customer obsessed and quality focused engineers with a desire to disrupt the way organizations manage and protect their data, to help them unleash the maximum value locked in their data. We are looking for an outstanding UI Engineer to expand our team of UI engineers that are excited about building quality products and delivering value to customers through simplifying the world of data management.
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Time Here**
As part of this team, you will design and build massively distributed systems at web-scale. You’ll be building the UI that is closest to the customers when they are interacting with Cohesity’s hyper-converged, highly-scalable storage clusters.
  
  
**WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING**

* 2+ years of developing and troubleshooting UI in large scale distributed systems
* BE/BTech degree in Computer Science with proficiency in data structures, algorithms, and software design. Master’s degree would be a plus.
* Strong understanding of UX and UI design principles
* Expertise in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Strong knowledge of front-end frameworks and libraries such as React, Angular
* Having worked on and understanding of large-scale engineering challenges and highly available distributed systems
* In-depth understanding of the entire web development process – design, development, and deployment
* Proficient understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them
* Excellent analytical and multi-tasking skills
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support decision making.

jobs.title: Website Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Leena AI**
Leena AI is a leader in
**Agentic AI**
for the enterprise. We are building an iconic company, delivering
**AI Colleagues**
that transform back-office functions and accelerate the full promise of Generative AI - unlocking real productivity gains, cutting costs, and delighting employees at scale.
  
  
Leena AI provides the most forward-looking, open, and scalable Agentic AI architecture for the enterprise - it empowers CIOs and CTOs to develop, deploy, and manage AI Colleagues for the back office at scale. Built with full governance, compliance, security, and auditability at its core.
  
  
Leena AI integrates with 1000+ applications, including SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft Office 365. We are proud to be trusted by 500+ global enterprises and 20 million+ employees, including leading brands such as
**Nestlé, Puma, Coca-Cola, Sony, and Etihad Airways.**
Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, Leena AI has secured over $40M in financing from top-tier investors including Greycroft, Bessemer Venture Partners, B Capital, and Y Combinator.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This role owns leena.ai website end-to-end: shipping website changes, standing up A/B testing, and driving conversion optimization. It also owns the initial PLG surface: improving the sandbox experience and building a lightweight product wedge that gives prospects self-serve value before a sales conversation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Website Changes & Page Development
* Own the leena.ai codebase (Next.js / React deployed on Cloudflare); ship new pages, redesigns, and campaign landing pages within days, not sprints.
* Implement responsive, accessible, and performant front-end code aligned with the Design team's specs.
* Build reusable page templates and component libraries so Marketing can compose pages with minimal engineering lift.
* Manage deployment pipelines, staging environments, and site reliability (uptime, Core Web Vitals, page speed).
* A/B Testing Infrastructure
* Evaluate and implement an A/B testing infrastructure that can be integrated with the existing analytics stack.
* Build the plumbing: experiment assignment, event tracking, statistical significance reporting, and audience segmentation.
* Create a self-serve experimentation workflow so Marketing and Growth can launch, monitor, and conclude tests without engineering tickets.
* Document experimentation standards (sample size, run time, success metrics) for the team.
* Conversion-Rate Optimization
* Instrument the full visitor funnel — landing → page scroll → CTA click → demo form submit → confirmation with event-level tracking (GA4, Segment, or equivalent).
* Analyze conversion data by page, traffic source, geography, and device to identify drop-off points.
* Run iterative experiments on headlines, hero sections, social proof, form fields, and CTA placement to improve demo-request conversion rate.
* Partner with the Marketing teams to close the loop from website lead to qualified pipeline, feeding learnings back into page design.
* Sandbox & Product Wedge
* Own the Leena sandbox experience reduce setup friction, improve time-to-value.
* Build and iterate on a product wedge: a self-serve tool on leena.ai (e.g., HR ticket analyzer, automation ROI calculator) that uses Leena's domain model to deliver value a general-purpose LLM can't replicate.
* Instrument the wedge funnel; signups, activation, engagement, PQL conversion.
* Work with Product to define what "product-qualified" means and how wedge usage maps to enterprise buying intent.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of professional front-end or full-stack web development experience.
* Strong proficiency in React and Next.js (SSR, SSG, API routes, image optimization).
* Solid HTML/CSS fundamentals; responsive layouts, accessibility (WCAG 2.1), cross-browser compatibility.
* Experience with at least one A/B testing or feature-flagging tool (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, VWO, or custom).
* Familiarity with web analytics platforms (GA4, Segment, Mixpanel, or Amplitude) and event instrumentation.
* Comfortable with CI/CD workflows, Git, and deploying to modern hosting platforms (Cloudflare Pages/Workers, Vercel, or AWS).
* Light backend experience is a plus: our site runs on Cloudflare Workers, so experience writing edge logic, simple APIs, or redirects in JS/TS (Workers, Pages, KV/D1) helps
* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and performance optimization (Lighthouse scores, lazy loading, bundle splitting).
* Strong communication skills; able to work directly with Marketing, Design, and GTM stakeholders without a PM intermediary.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company, especially in a growth or marketing-engineering role.
* Experience at a startup/ fast-paced growth teams
* Hands-on CRO experience; has personally run and analyzed multivariate tests that moved conversion metrics.
* Familiarity with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi) for marketing-managed content is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of SEO technical fundamentals (structured data, sitemap management, canonical tags, page speed).
* Exposure to tools like Hotjar, FullStory, or Microsoft Clarity for session recording and heatmap analysis.
* Design sensibility; can translate a Figma comp to pixel-accurate, polished UI without heavy design oversight.
* Basic data/SQL skills for pulling conversion funnel data from a warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery).

All Zadarians are finding their edge by living and breathing our core values; We are One Team, We are Respectful, We are Accountable, We are Achievers, We are Visionaries.
  
  
We believe that good things happen to people and business in a culture of choice. Where diverse and individual needs, wants and wishes are respected and rewarded — where the possibilities are limitless. Here you can, breakout and breakthrough to do your best work.
  
  
**What Diversity & Inclusion Mean To Us**
We are 'One Team' is one of Zadara’s core values and it’s more than just a phrase. It reflects our commitment to creating a Culture where every individual feels seen, heard, and valued. At Zadara, we celebrate the richness that comes from a wide spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, generations from Gen Z to Baby Boomers and the unique talents and skills each person brings. Our global team represents a vibrant mix of perspectives that fuels innovation, drives collaboration, and shapes a forward-thinking, people-centered workplace. At Zadara we embrace our differences and turn those differences into our greatest strengths. That’s how we grow stronger together.
  
  
**Your Team & Role**
The Software Engineer (Object Storage) is responsible for developing the core engine of Zadara’s high-performance, S3-compatible object storage solution. As a key component of the Zadara Edge Cloud, this general-purpose storage platform is designed for massive scale and high-throughput workloads, providing the essential data layer for enterprise applications and Sovereign AI solutions. You will architect and implement the distributed logic required to manage petabytes of data with extreme durability, ensuring that our infrastructure remains the gold standard for localized, secure, and high-performance cloud storage
  
  
**Your Day To Day (Duties & Responsibilities)**

* Design and implement robust features for the Object Storage engine, ensuring seamless S3 API compatibility and high-performance data management.
* Build and optimize distributed algorithms for data placement, replication, and erasure coding, ensuring the platform scales linearly to meet the demands of global edge deployments.
* Develop multi-threaded, asynchronous backend services capable of handling intense concurrent I/O and massive request rates.
* Optimize software to maximize IOPs and throughput on edge-native hardware, ensuring efficient CPU and memory utilization across the cluster.
* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for complex distributed system failures and performance regressions, providing architectural solutions that improve long-term resilience.
* Partner with distributed engineering teams across different time zones to ensure a unified architectural vision and synchronized release cycles for the Zadara Edge Cloud.
* Collaborate closely with QA and Automation teams to design comprehensive test plans, focusing on deep-dive system validation for complex storage scenarios.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies related to cloud computing.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years of experience
* Strong C, C++ or Golang programing skills
* Excellent understanding of Linux/Unix platform and the concepts
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* High motivation to work in dynamic and innovative startup

**Your education**
Bachelor's degree in computer science
  
  
**Benefits**

* Flexible work culture promoting work-life balance.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer 1
jobs.description:
**About the Team & Role**

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's Mobility organization.

  
  

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app scaffolding via Theseus Builder. In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Build specific components within an established architecture.
* You'll follow the patterns your team has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them.
* Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards.
* Before you start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're solving the right problem, not just writing code.
* Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks.
* You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching the symptom.
* Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under supervision.
* During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your confidence with live systems gradually and safely.
* Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug issues.
* You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should make it easier for others to do so.
* Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
* Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if something is at risk.
* You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first.
* Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos.
* You'll listen to stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not just whether it passed the acceptance criteria.
* Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked.
* Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system.
  

  

**Experience You'll Bring**

* You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience.
* You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional.
* You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought.
* You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on.
* You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure.
* When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due.
* You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution.
* Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging environment as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
* Familiarity with cloud basics even through coursework or personal projects.
* Exposure to containerization through Docker. Reading and running existing Dockerfiles counts, you don't need to have written them from scratch.
* Some experience working in an existing codebase, contributin improvements, and navigating code you didn't write yourself.
* Awareness of AI tools beyond code completion, such as experimenting with prompt design or modifying a simple AI-powered script or agent.
* A genuine interest in the domain. Payments, fleet operations, or developer platform work are exciting problem spaces and it helps to be curious about the industry, not just the tech

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Systems and Reliablity
jobs.description:
**Software Engineer – Systems & Reliability**
=============================================

**Smallest.ai** **| Bangalore**

**About The Role**
------------------

Own a service or a part of our product from design through production. You’ll write the code, validate its behaviour, deploy it and keep it reliable for the customers who depend on it.

Testing, deployment and operations are part of engineering ownership here. You’ll work with the team, but you won’t hand off responsibility when your code is merged.

Our systems power real-time voice, where an extra 100 milliseconds can change how a conversation feels. Behind that experience are GPU inference workloads for text-to-speech and speech recognition across AWS regions, alongside multi-tenant APIs, concurrency controls, billing and webhooks.

We work with Python, TypeScript and Go on Kubernetes in AWS, supported by Redis, MongoDB-compatible stores, Postgres, ClickHouse, RabbitMQ and Temporal. Familiarity helps; understanding the mechanisms underneath matters more.

**What you’ll own**
-------------------

* **Define success before building.** Establish measurable service-level objectives for customer-facing latency, availability and correctness.
* **Write maintainable code.** Build systems another engineer can understand, debug and operate without depending on you being available.
* **Test beyond the happy path.** Use unit, integration, load and fault-injection testing to validate behaviour under realistic conditions. Explain your coverage and its limitations in review.
* **Ship safely.** Own CI, deployments, rollbacks, schema migrations and infrastructure changes. When your work requires a Terraform change, you own that too.
* **Operate what you build.** Create useful dashboards, actionable alerts and runbooks. Participate in on-call, incident response and postmortems.
* **Stay close to customer impact.** When calls drop or requests fail, investigate directly, communicate clearly and drive the issue to resolution.
* **Improve the system around the problem.** Turn recurring incidents and manual debugging into better controls, automation and tooling.

**The challenges you’ll help solve**
------------------------------------

Our product works, and we’re strengthening the reliability practices that support its next stage of growth.

* Define SLOs for services that do not yet have clear reliability targets.
* Replace misleading health signals with monitoring that reflects whether customers can complete their tasks.
* Improve logging, health checks and alerting so failures are easier to detect and diagnose.
* Make testing and operational readiness a consistent part of delivery.
* Address existing reliability gaps alongside new product development.

You’ll fix problems you didn’t introduce and make decisions with incomplete information. You’ll also be expected to balance delivery speed with production readiness: surface risks early, propose practical trade-offs and follow through on commitments.

**What we look for**
--------------------

Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply them to unfamiliar problems. We assess these directly through technical discussion and practical reasoning.

You should be comfortable explaining and reasoning about:

* **Processes and operating systems:** Process creation, signals, file descriptors, namespaces, cgroups, PID 1 behaviour and CPU throttling.
* **Memory:** Virtual memory, page cache, available memory, swap, cgroup memory limits, out-of-memory behaviour and stalls that occur despite low CPU utilisation.
* **Files and storage:** Inodes, durability and fsync, disk-usage discrepancies, atomic rename, IOPS and throughput.
* **Networking:** TCP states, TIME\_WAIT, connection and read timeouts, Nagle’s algorithm, delayed acknowledgements, DNS, TLS, NAT and the trade-offs of UDP for real-time media.
* **Concurrency and distributed systems:** Race conditions, locks, idempotency, at-least-once delivery, retries, backoff, jitter, backpressure, clocks and partial failures.
* **Language runtimes:** Event loops, blocking operations, garbage collection, the Python GIL, memory leaks and algorithmic costs at production scale.
* **Data systems:** Indexes, query plans, transaction isolation, row and column stores, and replication lag.
* **Reliability:** SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, latency percentiles, why percentiles cannot simply be averaged, and alerting on customer-visible symptoms.

We also value clear writing, the patience to read unfamiliar code and the habit of measuring before drawing conclusions.

We evaluate demonstrated ability rather than years of experience, previous titles, employers, degrees, colleges, certifications or the number of frameworks on your résumé.

**How we work**
---------------

* **Be honest about what you know.** “I don’t know” is useful when followed by a clear approach to finding out.
* **Share hypotheses early.** Make your reasoning visible, invite scrutiny and update your view when the evidence changes.
* **Take responsibility and improve the mechanism.** Our postmortems focus on contributing causes and concrete changes that prevent recurrence.
* **Start with the customer’s experience.** A healthy pod does not mean a successful call. If the caller hears silence, we investigate it as a failure.
* **Use evidence.** Reach for traces, packet captures, profilers, query plans and load tests to understand what is happening.
* **Challenge ideas respectfully.** Question decisions—including those made by founders—with clear reasoning and evidence.
* **Automate repeated work.** When a problem keeps returning, build a better way to detect, diagnose or resolve it.
* **Move with urgency.** Make decisions at the right level, act on reversible steps and communicate blockers early. Use meetings when they help resolve a decision.
* **Hold yourself to the standard you expect from others.** Give direct, constructive feedback and receive it with the same openness.

**What to expect**

jobs.title: Cyber Operate - Pentesting - Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Consultant– AI/ML/DevSecOps / Application Security with strong hands-on delivery experience in SAST, SCA, and DAST to embed security across the software development lifecycle. This role focuses on implementing and operating application security tooling in CI/CD pipelines, executing application security assessments (including API security), triaging and prioritizing findings, enabling remediation, and driving secure-by-design engineering practices across cloud-native and enterprise applications. SAST, SCA, and DAST remain foundational AppSec capabilities, and the role is positioned accordingly with an emphasis on measurable delivery outcomes (tool onboarding, pipeline coverage, risk reduction, and remediation closure).

**Work you'll do**

As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

* Integrate, configure, and optimize static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including quality gates and exception workflows.
* Perform security assessments across application code, open-source dependencies, REST and GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs), cloud-native workloads, containers, and Kubernetes environments to identify vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, configuration gaps, and software supply-chain risks.
* Triage scan results, validate findings, prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability and business impact, and provide remediation guidance, compensating controls, and verification steps.
* Facilitate threat modeling and security design reviews; translate risks into secure design requirements, test cases, acceptance criteria, and engineering backlog items.
* Implement DevSecOps controls, including infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, container image scanning, policy-as-code, software bills of materials, and build and release integrity controls.
* Design and build artificial intelligence agents and agentic workflows for application security automation; assess AI/ML and generative AI application risks; and deliver client reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and implementation roadmaps.

**The team**

Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance

**Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata**

**Shift Timings: Rotational**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another technical discipline.
* 3-6 years of hands-on application security or DevSecOps experience, including operation of SAST, SCA, and DAST capabilities in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with at least one application security tool: Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Mend/WhiteSource, or Black Duck.
* Experience integrating security controls into Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, including pipeline templates, quality gates, and exception workflows; experience using Python or Bash for application security automation.
* Experience performing REST or GraphQL API security testing, including authentication and authorization testing, input validation, rate limiting, broken object-level authorization, and broken function-level authorization; experience with vulnerability triage and remediation validation.
* Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for modern applications, microservices, or APIs.
* Experience designing and building AI agents or agentic workflows for security or engineering use cases, including tool or function calling, multi-step orchestration, logging, guardrails, and human validation.

Preferred:

* Experience applying the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard to define or validate application security requirements.
* Experience implementing container or Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code controls.
* Experience implementing software or AI/ML supply-chain controls, including software bills of materials, model bills of materials, artifact signing or verification, dependency pinning, build provenance, model registries, or data and model lineage.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence security guidance, including OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, MITRE ATLAS, National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework, or Google Secure AI Framework.
* Experience implementing large language model guardrails, safety controls, or agent sandboxing patterns.
* Certification in DevSecOps, cloud security, Kubernetes security, AI security, or generative AI, such as Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, or AWS Certified AI Practitioner.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking

jobs.title: Mgr Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Manager, Software Engineering

Location: Bangalore, India
  
Employment Type: Full-time

Powering the World’s Payments Ecosystem

ACI Worldwide powers the payments ecosystem globally, and our people power ACI. Here, you’ll collaborate, innovate, and grow in a global technology environment where your work makes a visible impact.

As a Manager, Software Engineering, you will lead a talented engineering team supporting our Product Engineering team. You’ll combine people leadership, technical understanding, and delivery management to build secure, reliable, and high-quality software solutions. As Manager, Software Engineering, you'll lead the engineers who build and run it — on infrastructure that is evolving toward cloud-native as our end goal, with AI-assisted engineering practices built into how the team works day to day, not treated as a separate initiative.

What You’ll Do

  

* + Own delivery for ACI products end to end — plan and prioritize work that keeps commitments aligned with team and organizational goals, and remove the blockers that get in the way
* + Lead and grow a team of 10-15 full-time engineers: hire, onboard, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and create a climate where people are motivated to do their best work, not just show up. Overall span of control may extend beyond this range once contractor staff augmentation is factored in – and you’re accountable not just for filling the team, but for hiring quality: the long-term performance of the people you bring in
* + Own your team’s delivery and quality trends – deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, and MTTR - participate in sprint planning and retrospectives, and hold the team accountable to commitments without becoming a bottleneck yourself
* + Stay technically credible: participate in architecture discussions, review designs and code, and maintain enough hands-on comfort with where the team’s infrastructure stands today and where it is headed (cloud-native, Kubernetes/OpenShift, major cloud providers) to have a real technical opinion
* + Own reliability outcomes for your team’s systems – you’re accountable for customer-impacting incidents on your watch, and for ensuring postmortems produce tracked, measurable follow-through, not just a conversation
* + Use AI-assisted engineering tools yourself, and own AI adoption outcomes across your team – adoption rate, measurable impact on cycle time and quality – not just advocacy for the tools existing
* + Coach and develop your engineers' careers — identifying growth opportunities, giving direct feedback, and mentoring the team through technical and professional challenges
* + Communicate clearly with product, design, and other engineering teams, and represent your team's technical perspective to stakeholders who don't share your context
* + Partner with other engineering managers on cross-team technical initiatives spanning ACI's cloud infrastructure and platform investments
  
* Our Tech Stack

  You don't need full hands-on competency in this stack, but you should be fluent enough to review designs, make staffing calls, and comfortable enough to earn credibility with the team building on it.

  + Java / Spring ecosystem — enough depth to review designs and evaluate trade-offs in a Java / Spring Boot codebase (modern Java 17+, concurrency, performance considerations), without needing to write production code daily

  + Gen AI / LLM tooling — enough fluency with LLM APIs, RAG patterns, and AI coding assistants to review technical approaches and evaluate tool or vendor choices, without needing to build with them daily

  + Low-latency systems — familiar enough with the demands of transaction processing, payments, or equivalent high-throughput distributed systems to guide design decisions and set the right technical bar

  + Microservices & APIs — solid grounding in RESTful and event-driven service design, and in the trade-offs around API versioning, backward compatibility, and contract testing, to review architecture decisions confidently

  + Containers & Kubernetes — working knowledge of containerized applications running on Kubernetes (AKS, EKS, GKE, or OpenShift) — enough to evaluate designs and make informed staffing decisions
* + Cloud platforms — working familiarity with [Primary provider]; exposure to [secondary providers] a plus

  + CI/CD & DevOps — comfortable evaluating pipeline design and quality gates (e.g., [Jenkins/GitHub Actions/etc.], [Gradle/Maven/etc.]), even without being hands-on building pipelines yourself
  

What You Bring

You don't need to check every box below to apply — if most of this resonates, we want to hear from you.

* 6–10 years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated leadership experience – as a people manager, tech lead, or mentor guiding other engineers

* Strong critical thinking — you frame decisions clearly, weigh explicit trade-offs rather than defaulting to the familiar option, and adjust your thinking as new information comes in, especially under pressure or ambiguity

* Strong systems thinking — you reason about how components interact and where failure or complexity will emerge upstream and downstream, not just within the piece you're touching

* Solid grounding in SaaS and cloud-native fundamentals — the underlying principles, not just familiarity with the tools, even where our own infrastructure is still catching up to them

* Genuine curiosity — you ask why, you're not satisfied with 'it works,' and you bring creative approaches to problems that don't have an obvious answer yet

* A proven track record delivering software through teams using agile/scrum practices, with experience planning and prioritizing work against competing commitments

* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, APIs, and microservices — enough to stay credible in technical discussions

* Working familiarity with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container orchestration

jobs.title: SW Specialist
jobs.description:
Nasdaq is continuously revolutionizing markets and undergoing transformations while we adopt new technologies to develop innovative solutions, constantly aiming to rewrite tomorrow. To be able to continue and excel our exciting journey we need to continue bringing people with different experiences and backgrounds together.  
  
The Nasdaq Pre Trade Risk (Nasdaq PTR) team is now looking for a Senior Developer Specialist to join our team. NPTR gives Exchange members the ability to define, monitor and enforce risk limits on the trading activity of their trading participants. Exchange members are able to control the trading risk exposure at the level of a single trading participant, or for a group of trading participants. PTR will enforce the risk limits, reject orders that exceed the limits, and also notify PTR users when pre-set limit thresholds are crossed.  
  
With this position we offer:  
  
Stepping into this role, you and the team will work with PTR focusing on programming large, distributed systems with low latency and high availability. Our mission critical software runs in customer data centers all around the world. You will be part of a brand new and growing team of talented Java and React developers, and you will be involved in building up the team with the right people. You will guide them and coach them to become better developers and ensure that the team delivers great quality software.  
  
If you have a strong Object-Oriented and core Java foundation, are detail oriented, methodical, take pride in your work, and enjoy investigating new technologies, this job is right for you. Come join our team at Nasdaq, and help us expand our innovative solutions in fin-tech!

**Your roles and responsibilities include :**

  

As a **Specialist - Software Engineering**, your focus will be on developing and implementing software solutions. Besides working closely with your colleagues in **Bangalore**, you will also collaborate with Nasdaq teams across different countries.

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable software applications for Nasdaq’s market platform.
* Write clean, well-tested code and conduct code reviews to ensure high-quality standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance bottlenecks.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, engineering practices, and technical standards.
* Support the integration of platform components with internal and external systems.
* Work closely with architects and delivery leads across product teams to ensure seamless integration and collaboration between system components.
* Build and maintain automated tests to ensure product quality and reliability.
* Ensure the performance, scalability, and reliability of the platform.
* Actively participate in incident analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution when issues arise.

**What you would bring to the team:**

  

* Must have **6+ years of strong technical background with extensive experience in Java development.**
* Excellent communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while supporting demanding users.
* Passion for knowledge sharing, collaboration, and mentoring junior team members.
* Experience with **AWS cloud technologies, including EKS.**
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD practices and tooling.**
* Experience working in Agile teams using Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

**It would be great if you also have:**

* Experience in the Financial Field.
* Experience in developing low latency applications and have experience in writing GC-Free code.
* Experience in deploying systems both in the cloud and on prem.
* Experience with the Scrum Champion role.

**Does it sound like you?**

As the selection process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. We will get back to you in 2-3 weeks.

**Come as You Are**

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.
