jobs.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**The Role and Impact:**
------------------------

Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms.

Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use.

In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters.

This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it.

Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software.

If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection.

  

**About the Team:**
-------------------

The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms.

We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams.

Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy.

The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack.

* Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture.

* Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes.

* Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization.

* Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies.

* Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling.

* Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware.

* Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance.

* Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements.

Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

  

* BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms.

* Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements.

* Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust.

* Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior.

* Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

  

* Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8.

* Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent.

* Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms.

* Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling.

* Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions.

* Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects.

  

**Why Join This Team?**
=======================

  

This role gives you the opportunity to work across boundaries that few engineering positions span:

  

**Agentic AI & LLMs AI frameworks inference runtimes Linux server architecture silicon**

  

You won't be limited to measuring performance or optimizing an isolated component. You'll help connect the entire stack, identify where the real bottlenecks are, implement improvements, and make those optimizations available to developers and customers.

The result is tangible: better AI performance today, stronger software solutions for customers, and insights that can influence tomorrow's Intel platforms.

**Job Type:**
-----

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Role Overview:**

The Finance Innovation & Transformation (FIT) team is driving the next phase of Finance transformation at eBay through process modernization, data, and AI to build scalable solutions that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enable smarter decision-making. The team builds advanced AI and intelligent transformation solutions that turn high-value Finance opportunities into scalable, production-ready capabilities.

  
  

This role is for a hands-on AI Engineer and AI specialist who will serve as a core developer within FIT, designing, building, and deploying advanced AI, machine learning, and automation solutions for complex Finance use cases. The role includes developing production-grade models, web apps, intelligent agents, automation workflows, and decision-support tools, while translating business problems into scalable technical solutions from concept through deployment.

  
  

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in AI/ML, automation, system design and applied data science. They should be comfortable working across structured and unstructured data, building reusable capabilities, staying current with emerging AI technologies, and applying them to real Finance use cases. Passion for innovation, intellectual curiosity, and delivering measurable business outcomes through automation and AI are key to success

  
  

**Primary Job Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Finance and cross-functional stakeholders to shape solution approaches, translate prioritized business problems into **scalable technical and system designs, and drive execution of AI and intelligent automation solutions**.
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI, machine learning, and automation solutions using **core Python, SQL, modern AI/ML frameworks**, and related technologies to solve complex Finance use cases.
* Develop **intelligent agents, web apps, automation workflows, and decision-support tools** that move beyond analysis into execution and integrate seamlessly into business processes.
* Build and maintain robust data pipelines, model workflows, and reusable solution components that support scalability, reliability, and long-term adoption.
* Evaluate **emerging AI technologies and AI-assisted development tools**, and apply leading and emerging solutions where appropriate to accelerate implementation and create measurable business value.
* Monitor, refine, and scale deployed solutions to improve performance, reliability, usability, and alignment with evolving business needs.
* Partner proactively with teams across Finance, Product, Engineering, ITSS and other functions to ensure strong collaboration, visibility, and successful delivery across the solution lifecycle.
  

  

**Job skills required:**

* Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and comfort working in ambiguity and fast-evolving technology spaces.
* Proven experience building and delivering end-to-end AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation solutions from technical/system design and data preparation through deployment and ongoing optimization.
* Strong programming and technical skills in Python, SQL, and modern AI/ML frameworks; experience building scalable applications, automation solutions, or decision-support tools is highly valued.
* Experienced in handling big data (Hadoop, Teradata, etc.) and agile experience; Google Big Query experience is a plus
* Ability to translate business needs into scalable, maintainable software and automation solutions.
* Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor while collaborating effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and drive alignment across business, data, product, and engineering partners.
  

  

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience designing and delivering AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation solutions in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using modern AI/ML frameworks to build scalable technical solutions.
* Experience delivering production-ready solutions in complex, regulated, or controls-focused environments is preferred.

* Make outbound calls to prospective and existing Codingal parents to generate and qualify leads for coding classes.
* Run a customer needs assessment (CNA) on every lead understand the childs age, interests, school workload and the parents goals before recommending anything.
* Book and confirm free trial classes, and follow up with reminder calls so parents actually show up.
* Prime and nurture leads across channels calls, WhatsApp, email and SMS so no interested parent goes cold.
* Hand over qualified, well-documented leads to the Business Development team with clear context on what the parent wants.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in LeadSquared CRM and our telecalling tools every single day.
* Own your daily and monthly numbers — calls made, connects, CNAs completed, trials booked and trial attendance.
* Track your own performance metrics, spot what is working, and share it with the team.

  

**What we are looking for**

* 0–2 years of experience in pre-sales, telecalling, inside sales or customer support. Freshers with strong communication are welcome.
* Clear, confident and warm communication in English and Hindi, spoken and written. Additional regional languages are a big plus.
* Genuine empathy — you listen to what a parent is worried about before you talk about the product.
* The ability to ask sharp questions and qualify a need, rather than reading from a script.
* Comfort with numbers and targets, and the resilience to keep going in a high-performance environment.
* Strong multitasking and follow-through — you can hold 40+ conversations a day and still remember who needs a call back.
* A learning mindset. You should be able to understand our product well enough to speak to a parent about it within your first few days.
* Flexibility on working hours. Our parents are spread across 70+ countries, so some shifts include evenings or weekends.
* A graduate degree in any discipline.

  

**Why join Codingal**

* **Uncapped incentives.** Exceptionally high performance-linked rewards for top performers — your effort shows up in your payslip.
* **Real, fast growth.** We are scaling quickly and promote on performance, not tenure. Strong performers move into Business Development and then team leadership.
* **Genuine sales training.** You will learn structured discovery, objection handling and consultative selling — skills that stay with you for your whole career.
* **Work that means something.** Every trial class you book is a child who might discover they love building things. That is a good reason to pick up the phone.
* **A young, sharp team.** You will sit with people who are ambitious, collaborative and genuinely fun to work with, in our HSR Layout office.
* **Y Combinator-backed.** A globally recognised, well-funded EdTech company on your CV from day one.

  

**Where this role can take you**

We hire pre-sales associates as the start of a sales career, not a dead end. A typical strong performer moves along this path:

**Pre-Sales Associate Business Development Associate Senior BDA / Relationship Manager Team Lead**

  

Movement is based purely on performance. We would much rather promote from inside the team.

  

**Compensation and location**

* **Annual compensation:** 3,60,000 – 4,80,000 fixed per year, plus a variable performance incentive of up to 3,00,000. The final offer depends on your experience, communication skills and interview performance.
* **Location:** HSR Layout Sector 7, Bengaluru. This is an onsite role and cannot be done remotely.
* **Interviews:** Conducted at our Bengaluru office.

  

**Our hiring process**

* **1. Application review** — we look at your CV and communication.
* **2. Telephonic screening** — a short call to hear how you speak with people.
* **3. Interview at the HSR office** — including a live mock call with a parent scenario.
* **4. Offer** — we move fast and aim to close within a week.

  

**Frequently asked questions**

  

**What salary can I expect?**

* Embedded systems and electronics fundamentals.

* Knowledge of power electronics, batteries, and BMS.
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, I2C, SPI, and PWM.
* Hands-on experience with multimeters, oscilloscopes, and test equipment.

**Preferred Skills**

* UAV/Drone systems and avionics integration.
* PX4, ArduPilot, Mission Planner, QGround Control.
* STM32 microcontrollers.
* MATLAB/Simulink.
* EMI/EMC troubleshooting and validation.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Hands-on engineering mindset with ownership of projects.
